title: Muhammad
description: Prophet of Islam.

title: Hijra
description: Muhammad migrates from Mecca to Medina; Islamic calendar begins.

title: Death of Muhammad
description: Founding figure of Islam dies; Rashidun Caliphate begins.

title: Charlemagne crowned emperor
description: First Holy Roman Emperor crowned by Pope Leo III.

title: Diamond Sutra printed
description: Earliest dated printed book.

title: East-West Schism
description: Mutual excommunications split Eastern and Western Christianity.

title: Battle of Hastings
description: William of Normandy conquers England.

title: First Crusade declared
description: Pope Urban II calls for the recovery of the Holy Land.

title: Genghis Khan unifies the Mongols
description: Foundation of the Mongol Empire.

title: Mongol Empire
description: Largest contiguous land empire in history.

title: Hundred Years' War
description: Series of conflicts between England and France.

title: Magna Carta sealed
description: King John seals charter limiting royal power.

title: Marco Polo departs for the East
description: Polo begins his journey to the court of Kublai Khan.

title: Aztec capital founded
description: Tenochtitlan founded on Lake Texcoco (traditional date 1325 also cited).

title: Black Death reaches Europe
description: Plague pandemic kills a third of Europe over the next 4 years.

title: Peasants' Revolt
description: Major uprising against serfdom in England.

title: Joan of Arc executed
description: Joan burned at the stake at age 19.

title: Gutenberg's printing press
description: Movable-type printing demonstrated in Europe.

title: Fall of Constantinople
description: Ottoman conquest ends the Byzantine Empire.

title: Columbus reaches the Americas
description: European contact with the Americas begins.
